name: SDF-based Opacity Derivation via Logistic CDF
definition: A method to compute the discrete opacity $\alpha_i$ for a ray segment $[t_i, t_{i+1}]$ in volume rendering, derived from a signed distance function (SDF) $f$ and the logistic distribution's PDF $\phi_s$ and CDF $\Phi_s$. It solves the problem of correctly modeling surface opacity by ensuring the weight function peaks at the surface intersection, avoiding the bias of naive SDF-to-density mapping.
summary: SDF-based Opacity Derivation via Logistic CDF computes discrete opacity using the logistic CDF to ensure weight peaks at surface intersections, avoiding bias inherent in naive SDF mappings.
